reproduction.rationale: Compare independent paper_data and paper_data_author_code attempts with identical original observations, selected source support, evaluator access and cumulative search/resource budgets; frozen official code is the only information addition. The accepted primary is the Table 2 fixed-channel-mask and matching Table 17 language comparison: three pretrained spatial encodings and three matching random-initialized controls, sentence-onset and speech/non-speech, all seven test sessions, five fine-tuning seeds, the original random partition and all five chronological folds. Authentic recording/channel/annotation/session joins, original query and split identities, person-6 paper/code correspondence, validation-selected checkpoint/exposure lineage, complete per-query outputs and independent granular verification remain unresolved, as do source reductions and defensible reproduction criteria. Wider factorial, reconstruction, three-pretraining-seed, held-person-out and other programme results remain separate evidence and do not automatically gate this selected primary. Printed targets, source declarations, generated fixtures and author calibration do not establish AI reproduction; no protocol or execution qualification is supplied.

A fixed qualified competent author comparator, authentic same-support candidate/reference execution, matched exposure and validation/search budgets, meaningful endpoint-specific gains and dependence-aware paired uncertainty remain unresolved.
